description: Starts a short background job (Monitor), writes an update and ends its turn waiting on it (the turn parks). The job prints [script:voice-wait-done], so the wake turn (its completion notice) plays that scenario. For voice calls: the update before the wait is said, then the result.

steps.text: I'll start the build in the background.
The build is running in the background now. I'll wait for it and tell you the result as soon as it finishes.
